correctness.rationale: The half-line method-of-images kernel satisfies the degree-one boundary recurrence and decays; resolvent differentiation gives the finite rank-one trace gain. Log-concavity and strictly decreasing threshold polynomials prove the complete staircase and all ties. Rolle/Lambert analysis establishes inverse-square thresholds. The finite path Green diagonal factors exactly and uniform tail control plus a simple crossing derivative proves the asymptotic global switch and 27/4 coefficient. The standalone package checker passed 1762 exact and high-precision assertions. The infinite full trace is explicitly excluded.

value.rationale: The natural one-column trace-optimal landmark problem for an infinite reflecting tridiagonal inverse admits a complete all-screening site classification with infinitely many sharp phase boundaries. The first boundary is exactly 1/2, the weak-screening optimal depth is set by \(1+W(e^{-1})\), and finite ordinary paths have a nontrivial exponentially small, directionally sharp boundary interaction. These are usable selection and finite-size predictions rather than arbitrary sampled constants.
